blocks.text: After deploying the OVA (VMware) or VHD (Hyper‑V) file and powering on the virtual machine (VM), configure the scanner from the VM console and register it with DSPM.
Before configuring the scanner VM, make sure the following prerequisites are met:

blocks.item: Generate an API key in the Zscaler Admin Console.
Ensure the scanner VM has outbound internet connectivity to the DSPM services.

blocks.text: The following flowchart illustrates the step-by-step workflow for configuring and initializing the DSPM on-premises scanner VM, including the conditional proxy server configuration and automatic restart path.

blocks.item: Log in to the scanner VM with the default credentials:
Username: zdspmuser
Password: zscaler@scanner
Upon your first login, the system prompts to set a new password for the zdspmuser account. Follow the instructions to change the password.
Assign a static IP address, gateway, DNS servers, and an optional HTTPS proxy to the scanner VM. To set a static IP, run the following command:
sudo zds preconfigure
Enter the details for the following command prompts:
Enter IP CIDR to assign to VM (e.g., 10.25.32.12/24): Enter the static IP address and CIDR for the VM.
Enter Gateway IP: Enter the IP address for the default gateway.
Enter Primary DNS Server: Enter the IP address for the primary DNS server.
Enter Secondary DNS Server (Optional): Enter the IP address for the secondary DNS server, or press Enter to skip.
Configure HTTPS Proxy Server.(Requires VM Restart): Enter y to configure a proxy or n to skip. If you enter y:
Enter HTTPS Proxy Server: Enter the full URL of the proxy (e.g., https://test.server).
If you configure a proxy server, the VM restarts automatically to apply the changes. If you do not configure a proxy, the network settings are applied without a restart.
See image.
Verify that the IP address is assigned correctly:
ip addr
See image.
Run the following command to initialize the on-premises scanner VM. Replace <API_KEY> with the API key you generated in the Zscaler Admin Console.
sudo zds init <API_KEY>
See image.
(Optional) After the initialization is complete, run a health check to verify that all services are running correctly:
sudo zds healthcheck
See image.
Ensure the scanner VM has outbound connectivity to DSPM services. To learn more about the required IPs, see Understanding Orchestrator.

blocks.text: After the initialization completes, the scanner VM registers with the DSPM tenant, and the status changes to Operational in the Zscaler Admin Console. To learn more, see About On-Premises Scanner Integrations.
